detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Something I don't understand about modern web design is how I can have a screen that's 13 inches tall and 23 inches wide, and yet when I go to almost any website that sells things, I can see anywhere from 3-6 things at a time. At most. 

It's nearly impossible to compare items. On the Osprey site, where this screenshot is from, I can't even compare two rows of backpacks because of all the white space. At the size of those little photos, I should be able to see twenty packs on a single page. At least.

(FYI I'm looking at Osprey for fun, I don't need backpack recommendations - although I'd be having a lot more fun if the site design wasn't so bad)

#webdev #why
